name: What is the difference between restoration and remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between restoration and remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Restoration focuses on repairing and returning a damaged property to its original or pre-damaged condition, often after events like floods or fires. This involves replicating existing styles and materials. Remodeling, conversely, involves changing the structure, layout, or aesthetics of a space to update it, improve functionality, or change its design. While both involve construction, restoration prioritizes historical accuracy or original condition, whereas remodeling aims for modernization or transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration returns a property to its original state after damage, while remodeling updates or changes its design and functionality.
